اجتنيا (form VIII)
# اِجْتَنَيَا (ijtanayā) /id͡ʒ.ta.na.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)

# اِجْتَنِيَا (ijtaniyā) /id͡ʒ.ta.ni.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
